You can find information about civil and criminal cases in Virginia's General District Court and Circuit Court online by selecting an individual court location. To protect confidentiality, no case information is available online for Juvenile and Domestic Relations Court cases. Note that there is no statewide search option for circuit court cases, and many circuit courts use different online systems or may not have online case information available.
